description: This file defines the CheckoutActivity class for an Android application. The class manages the checkout screen of an online shopping platform, handling UI interactions, form data, coupon application/removal, order submission, and reactive UI updates based on ViewModel state.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: Android activity implementing the checkout UI, data binding, and interactions for an online shopping platform.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, ViewModel, and observers.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and back navigation.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Sets up text change listeners, button click handlers, and switch listeners for the checkout form.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds various ViewModel State flows to UI updates via coroutines.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Updates UI elements to reflect loading state during order submission.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Recursively enables or disables all views within a ViewGroup.
